claim: The framework ships only its own `cb:` graph (`beliefs/cb/`, one JSON file per node). Worked examples and other collections live in belief-collections (staged at `../belief-collections/`), each with a `manifest.json` declaring its namespace and cross-namespace `depends_on`; the `lib:` lending-library is the gentle on-ramp. Query a collection with `mix bs --beliefs <path>` - a single `beliefs.json` file or a per-belief directory both work - and verify one against its declared deps with `mix cb.verify.collection <namespace>`.

evidence.detail: The cb:b558 split (mix cb.migrate.split --write) moved the framework graph from the beliefs/beliefs.json array to per-belief files at beliefs/cb/<local>.json; the store reads and writes both layouts, so the query surface is unchanged. This node re-issues the collections convention with the storage naming corrected for the CLAUDE.md Collections section.

Accepted via human adjudication against cb:b454. Reasoning: The per-belief split (cb:b554, executed per cb:b558) removed beliefs/beliefs.json; the convention's parenthetical names a file that no longer exists on the CLAUDE.md read surface. Same convention, same section - only the storage naming changes, plus a note that --beliefs accepts either layout.
